title: Can Javascript call functions in other scripts?
summary: Discussion of code reuse between scripts; ends with a working eval-based loadLibrary() pattern that reads a .js file and evaluates it globally.

evidence.author: feloneouscat
evidence.quote: Hmmmm... didn't quite work...

evidence.author: feloneouscat
evidence.quote: At the top of your main file you MUST have the following:

evidence.author: podperson
evidence.quote: there is no "import" mechanism in C3D's script system, so each script needs to be self contained.

api_lessons: There is no import/include mechanism; a library can be loaded by reading a file (new File(path); open(READ_MODE); read(n)) and evaluating it.
A direct eval() inside a function defines the library only in local scope; use indirect eval (var geval = eval; geval(code)) so functions become global.
Wrap library functions in a namespace object (var Lib = new function(){ this.f = function(){...} }) and call them fully qualified (Lib.f) to avoid global name clashes.
Scripts cannot attach to the document itself, but tag scripts can attach to any object (including cameras and folders); scripts can share information through object parameters such as 'name'.
notes: Follow-up thread 12183 has a refined, username-independent version of loadLibrary. 2013, Cheetah3D 6.x.

api_lessons: A Polygonobj script's buildObject can rebuild geometry per frame from files: core.addVertex(false, Vec3D) and core.addIndexPolygon(count, vertexIndices, uvs); the script reverses OBJ index order to match Cheetah3D winding.

Malformed polygon data from a script (e.g. UV indices past the end of the UV list) raises JS errors in buildObject; some meshes that File > Import accepts can crash Cheetah3D in MWMValenceTable::buildValenceTable during normal building when made via addIndexPolygon. Validate faces before adding them.
Polygon script objects can set smoothing via obj.setParameter('normalType', ...) and obj.setParameter('normalAngle', ...).
notes: Unresolved; no fix found. The crash is inside Cheetah3D's normal building (buildNormal > buildValenceTable), triggered from setAnimPosition. The base script is from thread 2110. 2020, Cheetah3D 7.x.
